attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Create a FK Chain. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Mirror: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. AutoRotate: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 1). CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: lightBlue, blue, white, purple). CtrlType: choose one option (for example: square, sphere, cube, octagon). Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.
